scope: 15 report leads; primary documentation/schema/permission triage, not waveform qualification or experiment

candidates.name: Schuster maneuverRecognition
candidates.inputs: Published capture interval 500 ms (2 Hz); exceeds native development 50 ms interpolation bracket ceiling. Device-to-native preprocessing equivalence unverified.
candidates.labels: Dashcam manual maneuver classes and continuous_driving documented; no independently validated severe-event or normal-exposure protocol established.
candidates.groups: Three persons, three vehicles, shared route documented; driver/vehicle confounding remains.
candidates.permission: Dataset permission not established in reviewed README/paper or bounded license issue search; no claim that permission cannot exist.

candidates.name: UAH-DriveSet
candidates.inputs: Publisher describes smartphone accelerometers/GPS/camera and DriveSafe processing; raw gyro/native contract not established by page. Report's detailed delivered-rate claims not reverified here.
candidates.labels: Performed trip behavior and app-generated maneuver scoring documented; independent interval event/normal truth not established.
candidates.groups: Six drivers and vehicles documented; mapping not inspected.
candidates.permission: Custom non-commercial terms; abstract models allowed subject to restrictions; raw/modified dataset redistribution forbidden; no terms accepted.

candidates.name: Honda HDD
candidates.inputs: Instrumented vehicle, camera/GPS/CAN shown; native phone feature equivalence not established.
candidates.labels: Behavior examples documented; event/normal acceptance protocol not established by inspected publisher page.
candidates.permission: Non-commercial; publisher requires university affiliation/email to request download. No request submitted.

candidates.name: Brain4Cars
candidates.inputs: Paper's released modalities are inside/outside video, GPS and speed; compatible accel/gyro contract not established.
candidates.labels: Manual lane-change/turn starts and sampled straight-driving events documented; straight class is affirmative evidence, not native severe-event/normal exposure qualification.
candidates.groups: Participant data described; release grouping not verified without download.
candidates.permission: Repository license explicitly covers code and dataset for educational/non-commercial purposes.

candidates.name: KITTI Raw
candidates.inputs: Vehicle GPS/IMU and calibration documented, with synchronized 10 Hz representation; raw unsynchronized variant exists. No inference that original IMU is limited to 10 Hz.
candidates.labels: Published annotations describe object tracklets; independent maneuver/severe-event and normal-driving exposure contract not established.
candidates.permission: Intended-use dataset terms not requalified; download page requires login. No login or terms accepted.

candidates.name: comma2k19
candidates.inputs: Phone-like EON IMU, boot-time arrays, forward-right-down basis and Android gyro bias outputs documented; native preprocessing/quality equivalence not verified.
candidates.labels: Video, CAN and pose data documented; independent maneuver/normal interval annotations not established. CAN thresholds would create weak labels.
candidates.groups: Two vehicles/dongle groupings documented; device/route identifiers do not establish distinct drivers.
candidates.permission: MIT file defines software/documentation scope; no explicit recording/data grant established by reviewed README/license. No categorical claim data use is forbidden.

candidates.name: KAIST Complex Urban
candidates.inputs: ROS timestamps/calibration documented; early sequences only quaternion/Euler, later versions include gyro/acceleration; cannot treat all sequences as equivalent.
candidates.labels: Navigation/sensor formats and algorithmic pose baseline documented; independent maneuver and normal-exposure labels not established.

candidates.name: Ford Multi-AV Seasonal
candidates.inputs: Vehicle Applanix IMU, calibration and ROS bags documented; phone/native quality equivalence unverified.
candidates.labels: Mapping/pose ground truth documented; independent maneuver/normal truth not established.
candidates.groups: Multiple manually driven vehicles documented; vehicle count is not driver assignment.
candidates.permission: Ford-managed registry states non-commercial academic use, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

candidates.name: Drive360 / ICCV 2019 challenge
candidates.inputs: Paper records 200 Hz GoPro IMU acquisition; published challenge input list is camera/maps and 10 Hz CAN targets. Released native-compatible IMU not established; do not equate collection with release.
candidates.labels: Future steering/speed targets and intersection study annotations are not independent EventNet event/normal truth.
candidates.groups: Route/chapter split documented; driver mapping unverified.
candidates.permission: Challenge credentials/resources and intended-use grant not established; no access terms accepted.

candidates.name: V-SenseDrive-PK
candidates.inputs: Newer accepted article documents 10 Hz IMU, 1 Hz GPS and 166 ms median video alignment residual; not native feature equivalence.
candidates.labels: Authors explicitly identify released rule labels as speed bands; enacted session labels are separate. No independent interval maneuver/normal truth established.
candidates.groups: Article reports four drivers/vehicles; released rule labels D1-D3. Mapping not inspected.
candidates.permission: Article license is not a separate dataset permission grant; raw logs/video/code described as on request. No request submitted.

candidates.name: Wawage / Deshpande Mendeley v2
candidates.inputs: Publisher specifies accel m/s2, gyro degrees/s, nominal default 50 Hz and raw per-trip recordings; native frame/gravity/quality equivalence unverified.
candidates.labels: Page names behavior categories but does not establish independent event/normal annotation protocol. Report's stronger claim that files lack labels not independently rechecked here.
candidates.groups: Page reports three drivers/cars; driver-to-file mapping unverified.

candidates.name: Kaggle Large-Scale Driver Behavior Sensor Dataset v1
candidates.inputs: Official description states 2 samples/s, removed gravity and relative session time. Native timing/preprocessing incompatible or unverified; 1970-derived date alone is not clock corruption.
candidates.labels: Preassigned style classes; independent annotation provenance not established.
candidates.groups: Description states fully anonymized identity; no recoverable driver grouping established.
candidates.permission: Official API licenseName is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, correcting report's unknown-license claim.

candidates.name: Kaggle Popescu / Cojocaru Driving Behavior v2
candidates.inputs: Publisher description/paper specify 2 samples/s and removed gravity; native timing/preprocessing contract not satisfied.
candidates.labels: Paper describes separate enacted slow/normal/aggressive rides, not independent maneuver or reviewed normal intervals.
candidates.groups: Independent driver grouping not established by paper/description.
candidates.permission: Official API licenseName is Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0), correcting report's unknown-license claim.

candidates.name: Nazirkar Mendeley v1
candidates.inputs: Dashboard phone and acceleration/gyro columns documented; units/rate/gravity/frame/clock semantics not established.
candidates.labels: Merged-file normal/aggressive 0/1 labels documented; independent assignment procedure/normal intervals not established.
candidates.groups: Two source files do not establish two drivers; grouping unverified.

candidates.name: Zenseact Open Dataset
candidates.inputs: Publisher documents 100 Hz GNSS/IMU, 50 Hz consumer vehicle IMU, timestamps and controls; native phone preprocessing/quality equivalence unverified.
candidates.labels: Object/lane/road/sign/surface annotations listed; independent EventNet event/normal intervals not established.
candidates.groups: Fleet and drive subsets documented; driver assignment not established.
candidates.permission: Publisher explicitly states CC BY-SA 4.0 for commercial and non-commercial use; downstream obligations still require review.

evidence_limits: Web/publisher documents are dated review observations; Git blobs and three bounded HTTP bodies have additional content pins.
README previews contain illustrative data rows; those previews were visible during documentation review, not a newly downloaded motion corpus. Disclose qualification exposure in any future protocol.
No new archive/video/sensor-file retrieval, data split, waveform measurement, model fitting or predictions.

Failed web UAH retrieval followed by successful direct public HTTP page; Kaggle rendered pages empty, official API metadata succeeded with explicit review user agent; one follow-up without that header returned 404.
Wawage paper retrieval blocked; use only affirmative dataset metadata and unknown annotation status, not report-only claims about all released file contents.
Baseline Ferreira, Zenodo, Harvard, Q-Motion and VTTI qualification reused; other report exclusions not exhaustively re-audited.
No dataset claim means no qualifying corpus was established by this bounded review, not that no suitable corpus can exist.

decision.priority: Obtain independently annotated driving/normal exposure with compatible sensors/quality and independent driver groups; prepare collection/annotation protocol before new recording or any governed public reannotation.
